headline: Fed decision day: bitcoin is holding just above $80,000 ahead of the 2:00pm ET announcement, Coinbase says an analytics vendor exposed some customers' contact details, and Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% last quarter.

market.asOf: Prices read from the CoinGecko homepage at about 07:55 UTC Wed 28 Oct (14:55 Bangkok). 24h changes are left out because they shifted between our reads. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 48 (Neutral) on the CoinGecko homepage widget at about 07:55 UTC, which does not name the index provider; KuCoin's daily report gave 51 (previous 48) as of 00:00 UTC 28 Oct.

stories.title: Fed decision day: bitcoin holds just above $80,000 ahead of the announcement
stories.summary: The Fed announces its interest-rate decision at 2:00pm ET today (01:00 Thursday Bangkok), and most of the market expects no change. Bitcoin has spent the day just above $80,000. US growth and inflation data follow on Thursday.
points: The Fed's range is 3.75-4.00% after a hike in September; CME FedWatch showed 90.6% odds of a hold, up from 84.5% a week earlier, per Fox Business.
Chair Kevin Warsh holds a press conference at 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok), per Kiplinger.
Bitcoin traded between $79,416 and $81,159 over the past 24 hours, per crypto.news at 07:05 UTC.
About 14,942 BTC left exchanges on net in one day, the largest daily outflow in five weeks, per Santiment data reported by crypto.news.
US Q3 GDP and September PCE inflation are both due Thursday at 8:30am ET (19:30 Bangkok), per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Coinbase says a vendor exposed some customers' contact details; Bithumb and Korean brokers also hit
stories.summary: Coinbase says its analytics vendor Amplitude exposed contact information for a small group of its customers. Coinbase says its own systems were not breached and customer funds are safe. In South Korea, exchange Bithumb is still working out what leaked from a break-in at its internal staff app, and two finance groups reported attacks.
points: Coinbase said the exposure affects a "small subset" of customers and gave no count; it is emailing the people affected, per CoinDesk and Cointelegraph.
Coinbase said there is no evidence of unauthorized access to its own systems, per Cointelegraph.
Bithumb found the break-in on 27 Oct and reported it to KISA, Korea's internet security agency, and the Personal Information Protection Commission the same day, per Digital Today.
Daishin Securities said data on 38,490 customers leaked, per The Korea Times.
Leaked emails and phone numbers are often used for phishing: an exchange will never ask for your password or seed phrase.

stories.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue falls 55%; Coinbase and Strategy report Thursday
stories.summary: Robinhood's total revenue hit a record last quarter, but crypto trading revenue more than halved from a year earlier and the stock fell after hours. Coinbase and Strategy report their own results after the US close on Thursday.
points: Total revenue rose 12% to $1.42B; crypto revenue was $120M, down 55%, on crypto trading volume of $50B, down 38%, per the company's release.
Shares fell 7.36% after hours to $87.60, per Investing.com.
Coinbase reports after the close on Thursday 29 Oct, per its own announcement. Analysts expect a loss: -$0.23 a share on $1.21B revenue per MarketBeat, while CoinDesk lists -$0.10.
Strategy also reports after the close on 29 Oct, with a webinar at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the company.

briefs.title: Strategy shareholders vote today
briefs.summary: Strategy holds a special shareholder meeting at 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok) to vote on paying dividends daily on its preferred shares, per its SEC filing.

briefs.title: Bitcoin treasury stock halves over stuck withdrawals
briefs.summary: Datavault AI fell 49.55% after a filing said it has been unable to withdraw its bitcoin from exchange Biconomy since June, per U.Today.

briefs.title: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin coming to Robinhood
briefs.summary: Robinhood will add Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin before the end of 2026, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs kept taking in money
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $24.5M on 27 Oct after about $110.3M on 26 Oct, per SoSoValue data reported by crypto.news.

briefs.title: US and Canada move on stablecoin rules
briefs.summary: The OCC's GENIUS Act rules take effect 18 Jan 2027, and Canada's draft rules require reserves of at least 100%, with comments open to 23 Dec, per The Coin Republic.

briefs.title: Ripple wins final approval for its US trust bank
briefs.summary: The OCC, the US regulator for national banks, gave final approval to Ripple's national trust bank, the bank behind its roughly $2.6B RLUSD stablecoin, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Kraken's parent plans regulated perpetuals on Hyperliquid
briefs.summary: Hyperliquid says Payward, Kraken's parent, will be the first CFTC-regulated deployer of its HIP-3 markets, per The Block.

briefs.title: New Zealand surprises with a rate hold
briefs.summary: New Zealand's central bank kept its rate at 2.75% in a 4-3 vote when markets had expected a hike, per investingLive.

Coinbase Q&A 2:00pm PT; Strategy webinar 5:00pm ET (both 04:00 Friday Bangkok). Coinbase EPS consensus -$0.23 and revenue $1.21B (MarketBeat); CoinDesk lists -$0.10. Token unlocks the same day: FF (~$20.0M) and CARDS (~$18.7M), per the unlock data on this page.
